0022600024.text: The Suns (1-2, 1-0 at home, 11th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Pacific) host the Denver Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Northwest) in the fourth game of Phoenix's season and in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Phoenix lost all three games to Denver last season, most recently 125-123 in Phoenix on March 24, 2026. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision, while Denver is without Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring).
